title: Under the Mara Sky
subtitle: Three days on safari in the Maasai Mara.
story: I left Nairobi and headed out to the Maasai Mara for three days on safari. The drive out was part of the experience, but the real highlight was being out on the Mara and seeing the wildlife in a setting I had only ever seen in photographs.
